What’s going on at Baylor University? After exposing the administrative roadblocks that led to the cancellation of a recent college tour event, Frank returns to address some anticipated objections and dig even deeper into his concerns about the university. He’ll address questions like: How do Marxist principles conflict with biblical teachings on justice and impartiality? […]
